subject.why: The bookcase swinging open to reveal a secret stone staircase passage with the tilted lever book is instantly recognizable and complete.

category.why: The passage stands firmly on a wide band of polished floor in an appropriate stylized manor interior, matching Category 4.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, or characters are present.

framing.why: The secret passage is centrally framed with clear breathing room around the main structure, and the base naturally grounds along the bottom.

colour.why: The palette is vibrant, warm, and juicy with rich honey wood, deep green walls, and warm lighting inside the passage.

detail.why: Forms are chunky and simplified with no distracting micro-textures or excessive clutter.

style.why: Smooth, rounded 3D volumes with a soft satin sheen that perfectly match the reference cards.
